rejected: Led program delivery for the Agile Kookaburras squad, one of eight squads on the Payday Super reform program, managing sprint cadence, PI Planning (PI 47–48), capacity management, and executive status reporting to drive NTP & Distribution UI capabilities.

Authored an executive change request to re-baseline test capacity from 30 to up to 90 person-days, including options analysis, costed recommendation, risk assessment, and full Azure DevOps traceability across 40 scenarios and 11 data tables (AC6–AC19), enabling process improvement and compliance for STT regression scope.

Directed a program portfolio with a budget over $5M, leading 5+ cross-functional squads (up to 40 resources, including offshore teams) to deliver on-time, high-quality releases, ensuring operational excellence.
Delivered analytics and Business Intelligence (BI) projects to analyse operational data, boosting customer engagement by 20% and automating regulatory reporting workflows to achieve 100% accuracy.

Defined the technical vision and owned the product backlog and operational documentation for major platform modernisations, ensuring 100% compliance with enterprise architectural standards and risk models.
